theme.title: Top 8: The Team That Owns You

figure.name: Babe Ruth
figure.breakdown: In 1927 Babe Ruth hit sixty home runs and became the most replayed figure in a game most fans knew through print. His bylined column ran in syndication, much of it ghostwritten, and radio was beginning to carry him into rooms the stadium never reached. The 1920s press manufactured a 'hot romance' and he was its star.

figure.tell: A reader opening the sports page met a voice signed 'Babe Ruth' that Babe Ruth had not written, which is the manufactured reply end of a one-sided tie arriving in sports journalism: the attention felt answered, and the answer was an agency.

persona.title: AOC and the parasocial nature of politics
persona.why: A term coined for soap opera characters applied to a member of Congress, and the interesting part is that it works. Attachment to a person holding an office.

character.title: A clown got a prequel and four million households signed up without signing anything
character.why: A prequel with the same actor returning, four million households signing up without signing anything. The played role again, and the sequel is the proof the object survived the performer changing.

companion.title: A journalist spent a week with a Replika companion and came back unsettled
companion.why: A week with a companion app, reported as unsettlement by a reviewer who understood the appeal. The single most useful kind of story the site can hold, because it is neither enthusiast nor outrage.

divine.title: Eleven thousand years of pillars
divine.why: Provisional, and deliberately so. The pillars are anthropomorphic and the UNESCO nomination reads them as 'ancestors, perhaps even incipient deities', but nobody has settled it and other readings make them protective or totemic figures.

institution.title: Taylor Swift's re-recordings are a parasocial business model
institution.why: Owning your back catalogue framed as a relationship with an audience rather than an artist decision. The rights holder is the institution, and the story is about the institution owning the bond.

cosmology.title: The anime import boom
cosmology.why: The subject is a body of work crossing a border and acquiring a fandom that then organises around it. The attachment is to a canon with no author present, which is what makes the transnational part matter.

officer.title: The local news anchor
officer.why: One person on your own television, in your own town, for twenty years, who is leaving and everybody is upset. Proximity, not charisma, and the clearest case of the attachment accruing from duration.

predator.title: A glimpse is not a full picture and the comments decided otherwise
predator.why: Love Island and the World Cup producing millions of viewers who went on to investigate strangers. A relationship with an edited construct becoming a licence to intervene, and the in-group is the mechanism.
